issue.title: feat: Settings strict hierarchy - advanced/diagnostics behind secondary navigation

Settings must configure the system without requiring internal architecture knowledge and show important status/actions first.
Settings sub-sidebar, diagnostics route, and routing/memory boundaries.
Primary implementation surface for Settings navigation and section rendering.
App-level Settings default section and diagnostics-loading trigger.
Component contract tests for hierarchy and Advanced internals.
Integration contract tests for provider diagnostics, provider creation, memory bridge, and unrelated regression checks.
